items.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued September 9 at 2:58AM PDT until September 9 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Extreme Heat Warning, dangerously hot conditions
with high temperatures in the mid 80s to lower 90s at the beaches
to around 100 higher coastal terrain with low temperatures in the
lower to mid 70s. For the Heat Advisory, high temperatures in the
80s and lower 90s.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas and San Diego County Coastal
Areas.

* WHEN...For the Extreme Heat Warning, until 8 PM PDT this evening.
For the Heat Advisory, from 8 PM this evening to 8 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Major to Extreme HeatRisk through today. Warm
overnight low temperature will limit relief from the heat.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 9 at 1:30AM PDT until September 9 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding from high tides this evening.

* WHERE...Beaches of Orange and San Diego Counties.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Most likely during Wednesday
evening's high tide.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides this evening at Newport Beach: 6.3
feet at 845 PM. At La Jolla: 6.3 feet at 839 PM. Measured high
tides are exceeding predicted levels by 6-7 inches.
items.instruction: High tides could generate flooding of low areas along the shore.
